newsitem.title: JAPAN: IGS shares suspended from OTC trading for Thursday.
newsitem.headline: IGS shares suspended from OTC trading for Thursday.

text.p: Shares in IGS Corp will be suspended from trading in the over-the-counter market for the whole day on Thursday, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association said.
On Wednesday, the medium-sized software development firm said it had applied to Tokyo District Court for court mediation with its creditors.

IGS said in a statement that its debts totalled five billion yen. But the company, which was established in 1971, said it could rebuild its business if it was allowed to restructure under court protection.
Court mediation is a process under which troubled entities can avoid going bankrupt and continue in business under supervision.
The company said it became insolvent as a result of large capital investment related to information systems and telecommunications.
